figures.definition_text: Whether any related person has been confirmed by the client for this engagement (the SAME [related_parties] config related_parties_cl23 reads). 'no' means none were confirmed and this test reports nothing further.

findings.title_text: A comparable is needed to test the 'other' amount paid to related person (tag c9ef7ace) under s.40A(2)(b)
limits_text: s.40A(2)(b) disallows only the part of this amount that lies above a market comparable; the books show only the amount that moved, never a market rate or price, so this test takes no view on how any part of it compares to the comparable.
ask_client_text: Obtain a comparable arm's-length rate or amount for this nature of transaction and record it as the basis for this amount.
Confirm the business need for the transaction.

findings.title_text: s.40A(2)(b) does not apply to this amount for related person (tag cf249b09) -- s.40(b) governs instead (confirm)
limits_text: Related person (tag cf249b09) is recorded with relationship 'partner', a client confirmation of partner status, and this engagement's rules apply s.40(b) to a partner's interest and remuneration; on that basis s.40A(2)(b) does not additionally apply to the same amount. This rests on the client's own confirmation, not a reading of the deed, so it is stated here for confirmation, not as a settled fact.
ask_client_text: Confirm the partnership deed treats this amount as partner interest or remuneration under s.40(b), not a separate related-party payment under s.40A(2)(b).
